Unresolved information

  • Record and sample-context counts do not count independent physical batches.
  • Five source-defined preparation conditions are not a Cartesian grid; source loading ratios are not recalculated from unknown stock molarity.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • C11: The authors describe300 nm excitation as enabling above-gap carriers while optical gaps are~4.8–5.0 eV. No source correction or new microscopic mechanism is inferred; these are distinct source statements.
